name: BIG_DATA_EVOLUTION_GOVERNANCE
purpose: Prevent short-window overfitting while allowing bounded recent-context adaptation and explicit reproducibility learning.

structural_big_data.role: Horse ability, class, surface/distance aptitude, running-style robustness and long-run jockey/trainer baselines.

medium_term_form.role: Recent 3-5 starts and 30-90 day condition/form information. May reorder close candidates but may not erase structural evidence.

short_term_context.role: Race-specific context correction only; never the base ability model.

evolution.rule: A 36R block is diagnostic evidence, not a training population by itself.

repeatability.learning_rule: Persist repeatability score, positive-round ratio, median, worst block and dispersion. Models with strong one-off results but weak independent replication are learned as unstable and cannot become the production parent.
repeatability.retest_trigger: Any model that wins an initial comparison must enter repeated independent validation before inheritance or production promotion.

optimization_targets.principle: Improve trio capture through the shared horse-selection core so derived wager types improve together; do not optimize an isolated trio-only horse ranking.

leakage_policy: Prediction inputs must be knowable before the prediction seal. Results, popularity, odds and payouts cannot affect pure prediction before SHA256 sealing.
